quote: Decepcionante, claramente politicagem e péssimos hábitos forçados. Repleto de bugs que interferem na experiência.

author: Rhot
quote: Masterpiece. This game presents a story worthy of Oscar, with a complete enlargement of the first game, a very satisfying gameplay. The negative reviews were caused by naughty dog, lying in the trailers and not presenting Abby properly, bringing the game an experience that few expected. However, the story remains brilliant, and the game is worth a score of 10. I feel sorry for the   developers suffering child attacks from people with weak minds however, I admire the courage to go against the tide. People were not ready to The Last of Us Part II.
game_title: The Last of Us Part II
